verdicts.why: Seed has 'her' (L3 ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಾಗಬೇಕು => her to know); 'she' is the nominative form of a pronoun that is in the sentence, so the row is about its sentence.
ಅಂತ is in its own LEGO 'ಅಂತ ನಾನು ಕೇಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಿಲ್ಲ' and the sentence 'I didn't hear what she said to him' drops the particle 'that'.
ಅಂತ is in its own LEGO and the seed 'No I didn't know what she was doing' renders no 'that'.
ತುಂಬಾ is in the seed known and in its LEGO 'ನನಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಇಷ್ಟ => I love'; the seed 'I love the way you try to help' folds it into 'love'.
ಅಂತ is in its own LEGO and the seed 'Did you ask where he wanted to put it?' has no rendering of 'that'.
ಅಲ್ಲ is in its LEGO 'doesn't mean'; the seed's 'doesn't' contains the negation, so 'isn't' is a gloss of a word fused into 'doesn't'.
ಅಂತ is in its own LEGO 'ಅವಳ ಹೆಸರು ಏನು ಅಂತ => what her name is'; the seed 'ask her what her name is' renders no 'that'.
ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ is in the LEGO 'when you work together'; 'when do' is a literal gloss of a form the seed renders as 'when you work'.
ಅಂತ is in its own LEGO 'ಸೋಲಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ನಾನು ಯೋಜಿಸ್ತಿಲ್ಲ' and the seed 'I'm not planning to lose' has no 'that'.
ಇಷ್ಟ is in the seed and its LEGO (=> 'I love'); the seed says 'love' where the row says 'like', a lemma/synonym of the word the sentence uses.
ಅನ್ನೋ is in its own LEGO 'about what they were doing'; the seed 'about what they were doing' has no 'that'.
ಇದೆ is in its LEGO; the seed 'It's near where your family live' has 'is' fused into the contraction "It's", which sibling C01 also glosses.
ಅಂತ is in its own LEGO 'ನಮಗೆ ಬಿಡ್ತೀನಿ ಅಂತ ಮುಂದಾದಳು' and the seed 'She offered to let us stay with her' renders no 'that'.
ತುಂಬಾ is in the seed known and its LEGO 'that would be great'; the translation drops 'very' ('would be great').
ಬೇಕು is in the seed known and its LEGO; the seed 'What would you like?' renders it as 'like', not 'want'.
ಚಿಕ್ಕ is in the seed known and in L1/L2; the seed 'the least I could do' renders it as 'least', so 'small' is a literal gloss of a word the translation changed.
ಕೋಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ is in the seed and LEGO 'keep in another room'; the seed 'in another room' interposes 'another' between 'in' and 'room'.
ಶಕ್ತಿ is in the seed known and its LEGO 'he couldn't afford'; the seed 'couldn't afford' renders no 'the ability'.
ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳ => 'of the shops' matches its own LEGO L2, but the seed says 'down to the shops' with no 'of', so the LEGO disagrees with the seed.
ಕೋಣೆಯ is in its LEGO 'of my bedroom'; "room's" is the genitive of a word the seed renders as 'bedroom' in 'my bedroom window'.
